filter_action:Changes behavior of filtered tests using attributes, valid values are: <none>: do not run filtered tests as normal 'skip': skip all filtered tests instead so tests will appear in output  (charp)

filter_glob:Filter which KUnit test suites/tests run at boot-time, e.g. list* or list*.*del_test (charp)

action:Changes KUnit executor behavior, valid values are: <none>: run the tests like normal 'list' to list test names instead of running them. 'list_attr' to list test names and attributes instead of running them.  (charp)

force_legacy:Force legacy mode for transitional virtio 1 devices (bool)

disable_bypass:Disable bypass streams such that incoming transactions from devices that are not attached to an iommu domain will report an abort back to the device and will not be allowed to pass through the SMMU. (bool)
